title: Buy Now Pay (Pain?) Later
eligible_reason: The DiD (Figure 2) is a matched-pair event-window design, not an unstacked TWFE: each BNPL adopter is matched to a non-user (match_id), each individual contributes eight quarters around the adopter's first BNPL quarter, and the regression absorbs individual x match FE (mid1 = group(idnum match_id)) and state x year-quarter FE with treated x event-quarter indicators (pt_3..pt4) plus event-quarter indicators for all matched units (post_3..post3), i.e. event-time main effects for all units (PROTOCOL 5b), and time-varying controls (income tier updated monthly, student-loan, mortgage, wage direct-deposit indicators). Table 3 is IV (ivreghdfe) with pre-period outcome levels and trends as controls.
design_notes: Code/Regression.do. Part 1 (Table 3): reghdfe/ivreghdfe on replication_iv.dta, d_treat instrumented by lpartner12_num (BNPL exposure), state x year-quarter FE, clustered by year-quarter. Part 2 (Figure 2): reghdfe loverdraft_num / linterest / llate_num on pt_3 pt_2 pt_1 pt1-pt4 post_3 post_2 post_1 post1-post3 income d_sloan d_mortgage d_wagedd, absorb(yqtsta mid1), cluster(yqt mid1), lines 117 and 128. SAS code for sample construction is referenced but not shipped (Sample and Descriptives.sas missing).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Adoption quarters vary across individuals, but each matched pair is analysed in its own eight-quarter window.

specs.exclusion_reason: matched-pair stacked windows with event-time main effects for all units (post_*), time-varying controls, mock data
specs.outcome: loverdraft_num (also linterest, llate_num for card holders, line 128)
specs.treatment_var: pt_3 pt_2 pt_1 pt1 pt2 pt3 pt4 (treated x event quarter)
specs.treatment_definition: BNPL first use; pt_k = adopter in event quarter k
specs.controls: income d_sloan d_mortgage d_wagedd; post_3 post_2 post_1 post1 post2 post3

data_files_note: README: 'a folder that includes the mock datasets ... we include a small sample of one hundred individuals. The mock dataset is intended to help readers understand the overall structure'. Treated as mock data; underlying transaction data are proprietary (service-provider panel).
software_notes: Stata (reghdfe, ivreghdfe, outreg2) plus SAS for sample construction (SAS file not shipped).
priority_note: Matched stacked event windows with controls; mock data.
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Add to data/synthetic_packages.txt (mock 100-person files).
